description: If you’ve voted Republican your whole life, I want you to know I hear you. You believe in responsibility, in fairness, in people earning their way. You don’t want government overreaching, and you don’t want chaos. Solid values. But I also know that some of what you’re seeing lately doesn’t sit well with you.
